title: Event Marketing Manager
description: ABOUT FIELD MATERIALS AI Field Materials is the leading AI platform for construction procurement, AP automation, and inventory management. Integrated with all major construction ERPs, its AI agents eliminate data entry for vendor documents and automate workflows across purchasing, inventory management, accounts payable, and prefab operations. The company has grown 3x over the past year and is now processing $2.5B+ in construction purchasing volume. Founded by serial entrepreneurs with successful exits to Fortune 500 companies (including PayPal), the company has raised over $20M in total funding and is backed by leading Silicon Valley venture capital funds and senior executives from companies like Lowe's and Google. Our company is the people we hire. We aspire to build a team of smart, high-caliber players that inspire each other to excel yet are not afraid to leave egos behind, roll up their sleeves, and fix what doesn't work. We don't believe in micromanagement and trust our team to take full ownership of their responsibilities. We believe in transparency as a way to build trust, break communication barriers, and align towards a common goal. ABOUT THE ROLE As our Event Marketing Manager, you will own the engine that drives demand for Field Materials AI from trade shows and virtual events. This is a hands-on, full-stack marketing role. One day you'll be managing trade show logistics, the next building a HubSpot report to prove the event-generated pipeline, and the next you'll be building a Hubspot audience for a trade show or a webinar. You will be the connective tissue between our events and sales motion, making sure every event is measured, repeatable, and tied to revenue. This is a high-ownership role with broad scope and real visibility, ideal for an operator who loves both the creative side of marketing and the analytical rigor behind it. If you are energized by building marketing processes from the ground up in a fast-growing AI startup, this is the perfect place to be. RESPONSIBILITIES - Plan and execute trade shows and events end to end — logistics, booth, collateral, lead capture, on-site coordination. - Own company swag and marketing collateral for customers, prospects, and employees end to end — sourcing, inventory, and budget — and build a repeatable process to distribute it to the right people at the right time. - Plan and run webinars, including co-hosted sessions with integration partners and professional associations — from scheduling and webinar platform logistics to promotion and follow-up. - Build pre/post-event email campaigns to drive attendance and conversions, for both physical and virtual events. - Run paired social media campaigns promoting events and webinars, leveraging Hubspot audiences and creative templates provided by the company. - Track event and webinar ROI and leads in HubSpot, turning data into clear recommendations. ABOUT YOU - Owner Mindset: You take full responsibility for outcomes and don't wait for instructions to improve a process. You're comfortable building the playbook, not just running it. - Analytical & Creative: You're equally happy in HubSpot reports and a creative brief. You like proving what works with data and aren't satisfied with vanity metrics. - Hands-On Operator: You enjoy "rolling up your sleeves," juggling events, campaigns, and deadlines at once without dropping the ball. - Strong Communicator: You can write clean, compelling copy in a way that resonates with construction professionals, from CFOs to field operations leaders. - Bias for Action: You move fast, ship, measure, and iterate, and you thrive in the ambiguity of a fast-paced startup. REQUIREMENTS - 3+ years of experience in field/event marketing (B2B SaaS experience strongly preferred). - Hands-on proficiency with HubSpot (or a comparable marketing automation/CRM platform), including building campaigns, workflows, and reports. - Demonstrated experience planning and executing trade shows or events end to end. -

You will own all content production at Hercules - Lead: Manage a team of ~10 full-time employees + contractors - Content standards: You will enforce and raise the bar for content across the company - Marketing angle and messaging: You will own ad prioritize the market angles and messaging we pursue at the company - Written content: You will lead our content strategy and production across SEO, blog, social media, product announcements, case studies, Google ads, and more - Static image content: You will lead our static image content strategy, primarily used on Meta - Video content: You will lead our video content strategy for paid ads like Youtube and Meta, as well as video customer stories or announcements - Paid and organic: You will own content across paid and organic - Hire: You will help hire/manage writers, editors, designers, and other creators What skills do we expect you to have? We expect candidates to be incredibly strong across all of the following areas: - Writing quality: exceptional long-form writing ability. Our style is terse, simple, clear, convincing, authentic, and useful. We do not accept AI slop. A track record of strong written communication is a hard requirement - SEO: strong understanding of search intent, content structure, on-page SEO, internal linking, content refreshes, and what it takes for content to rank - Commercial sense: create content that ranks AND converts the audience to paid customers - Technical fluency: familiarity with technical concepts like APIs, authentication, hosting, role based access control etc - AI leverage: 10x your workflow by using the frontier of AI tools well. We expect you to be able to product ~50+ high quality articles a month, if not more - Hiring and management: We expect you to have a background managing at least 15 people What are Hercules’ operating principles? Hercules’ operating principles guide how we make decisions every day. We take them very seriously. Most of the principles can be learned on the job, however, we do specifically filter for the following principles in our hiring process: 1. We ship. We ship fast, iterate, and correct mistakes quickly. Our bias for action speeds up our learning and delights our customers. 2. We strive for excellence. Doing things well is in our DNA. We have good taste. We get the details right. Our outputs are exceptionally simple and self-serve. We’re proud of our work. 3. We are hungry. We are willing to work hard and break through walls to achieve the outcomes we want. We are willing to operate at any level to get things done. Is Hercules in-office or remote? Hercules founding team works in-office in San Francisco (Kearny and Bush). We have a very strong preference for in office. We are open to remote for exceptional candidates who are willing to 1) work in US time zones and 2) travel to the office regularly. What are Hercules’ benefits? - Unlimited AI token budget - Take what you need vacation policy - Healthcare, vision, and dental - Daily lunches, dinners and snacks in the office - We guarantee you will do the best work of your career here What’s the compensation? $100k-$300k + equity (variable based on seniority, equity, and location)

title: Demand Generation Manager
description: ROLE OVERVIEW The Demand Generation Manager will own the top and middle of Audiohook's marketing funnel — building, executing, and optimizing coordinated GTM and digital marketing programs that generate qualified pipeline, accelerate sales cycles, and establish Audiohook as the category leader in performance audio advertising. You'll partner closely with Sales, Product Marketing, and Leadership to ensure every campaign is sharp, measurable, and tied to revenue. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES COORDINATED GTM - Partner with Sales and Product Marketing to design coordinated GTM motions for new product launches, feature releases, and segment expansions - Ensure messaging, targeting, and timing are aligned across every channel and customer-facing team - Build and scale ABM programs targeting priority brand and agency accounts in coordination with Sales DIGITAL MARKETING & CAMPAIGNS - Build and execute a multi-channel demand gen strategy across paid media, SEO/SEM, content syndication, email nurture, and events - Manage paid media budget across LinkedIn, Google, programmatic, and industry publications — optimizing for CAC, pipeline velocity, and ROI - Own digital campaign operations end-to-end: setup, audience segmentation, landing page optimization, conversion tracking, and reporting - Partner with Content and Product Marketing on lead-generating assets: webinars, whitepapers, case studies, and gated reports MARKETING OPERATIONS & ANALYTICS - Develop and maintain the marketing tech stack (CRM, marketing automation, intent data, analytics) and ensure clean data flow between systems - Build attribution models and report on funnel health, channel performance, and pipeline contribution in weekly leadership meetings - Increase marketing-sourced pipeline by a measurable amount within 6 months of hiring CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COLLABORATION - Partner closely with Sales on lead routing, follow-up SLAs, and pipeline reviews - Communicate clearly and proactively in a remote-first environment QUALIFICATIONS REQUIRED - 5+ years of B2B demand generation experience - Proven track record of building demand programs from scratch and scaling them — not just optimizing existing playbooks - Hands-on expertise with marketing automation platforms (HubSpot, Marketo, or similar) and CRM (Salesforce or HubSpot) - Deep fluency in paid media — particularly LinkedIn, Google, and programmatic — including campaign architecture, audience strategy, and performance optimization - Strong analytical skills; comfortable building attribution models, forecasting pipeline, and making budget decisions based on data - Excellent written communication and the ability to brief creative, agency, and internal partners PREFERRED - Experience in adtech, martech, or SaaS - Experience running ABM programs at scale - Experience in a startup or high-growth company - Comfort using AI tools to plan campaigns, draft copy, and analyze performance WHAT WE OFFER - Fully remote work environment - Competitive salary and equity opportunities - Performance bonuses - Health, dental, and vision benefits - Other benefits such as daily lunch stipend, monthly wifi, cell phone and subscription reimbursement, and annual hardware stipend - Flexible PTO and remote-friendly culture - Bi-annual Corporate Offsites - Opportunity to help shape a function at a rapidly scaling tech company

title: Product Marketing Manager
description: ROLE OVERVIEW The Product Marketing Manager will own how Audiohook is positioned, launched, and adopted — with a special emphasis on post-close activation. You'll make sure customers don't just sign on, but quickly reach value, expand usage, and become long-term advocates. This role partners closely with Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Demand Gen to turn our platform's strengths into clear customer outcomes. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES POST-CLOSE ACTIVATION - Design and operationalize the customer onboarding journey, in-product education, and lifecycle communications that drive time-to-value and feature adoption - Partner with Customer Success and Sales to identify activation drop-off points and ship targeted programs to improve them - Increase 90-day customer activation rate by a measurable amount within 6 months of hiring - Build customer-facing case studies, testimonials, and reference programs that fuel both new business and expansion POSITIONING & MESSAGING - Own positioning, messaging, and narrative for Audiohook's platform and key product lines - Conduct ongoing customer, prospect, and competitive research to sharpen positioning and identify opportunity areas LAUNCHES & SALES ENABLEMENT - Lead go-to-market for new product launches: positioning, sales enablement, customer comms, launch assets, and measurement - Build sales enablement assets: pitch decks, one-pagers, battle cards, ROI calculators, and objection-handling guides CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COLLABORATION - Partner with Demand Gen on campaign messaging and Product on roadmap inputs from the field - Communicate clearly and proactively in a remote-first environment QUALIFICATIONS REQUIRED - 4+ years of B2B product marketing experience - Demonstrated experience owning post-close activation, onboarding, or lifecycle marketing — not just top-of-funnel launches - Strong writing skills; able to turn complex technical capabilities into clear, compelling narratives for buyers and users - Hands-on experience with product launches end-to-end: positioning, enablement, comms, and measurement - Comfortable working directly with customers — interviews, advisory boards, win/loss research PREFERRED - Experience in adtech, martech, or SaaS - Experience building reference programs or customer advocacy motions - Experience in a startup or high-growth company - Comfort using AI tools to research, draft, and iterate on messaging WHAT WE OFFER - Fully remote work environment - Competitive salary and equity opportunities - Performance bonuses - Health, dental, and vision benefits - Other benefits such as daily lunch stipend, monthly wifi, cell phone and subscription reimbursement, and annual hardware stipend - Flexible PTO and remote-friendly culture - Bi-annual Corporate Offsites - Opportunity to help shape a function at a rapidly scaling tech company

title: Strategic Affiliate Partnerships Manager
description: ABOUT AUDIOHOOK Audiohook is a fast-growing technology company transforming the way brands connect with audiences through audio. We build innovative tools that help advertisers reach listeners across streaming platforms, podcasts, and emerging audio channels. As we scale, we're looking for a Strategic Affiliate Partnerships Manager who thrives in a dynamic, fully remote environment. ROLE OVERVIEW The Strategic Affiliate Partnerships Manager will work directly with the Director of Affiliate Partnerships to expand Audiohook's presence across the affiliate marketing ecosystem. This is a hands-on role combining strategic relationship management, partner development, prospecting, partner activation, and pipeline generation. The ideal candidate understands the affiliate industry, is comfortable building relationships from the ground up, and can independently manage existing and prospective partners. As one of the first dedicated hires within the Affiliate Partnerships function, this person will also play an important role in establishing processes, improving partner engagement, and helping build the foundation for future growth. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES - Build, manage, and grow relationships with affiliate networks and affiliate management agencies, developing these partnerships into consistent sources of qualified advertiser opportunities. - Identify opportunities to establish new partnerships across the affiliate ecosystem. - Turn partner relationships into active, productive sources of advertiser opportunities, including educating partner teams, identifying brands within network and agency portfolios, and facilitating introductions. - Develop repeatable strategies for generating qualified pipeline through affiliate channels. - Help establish processes and improve partner engagement as one of the first dedicated hires in the function. - Work cross-functionally to ensure partner-sourced opportunities are properly handed off and supported. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS - Understanding of the affiliate marketing industry, including networks, affiliate management agencies, and how affiliate-sourced pipeline is built. - Demonstrated ability to build relationships from the ground up and independently manage existing and prospective partners. - Experience with partner prospecting, activation, and pipeline generation. - Strong organizational skills with the ability to bring structure and process to a newly developing function. - Strong communication skills, including the ability to educate partner teams on products and opportunities. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS - Experience with affiliate networks, partnership marketing, or marketing technology platforms. - Experience working at an early-stage or high-growth company where individual contributors regularly shape process, not just execute it. - Familiarity with performance marketing and customer acquisition channels. WHAT WE OFFER - Fully remote work environment - Competitive salary and equity opportunities - Performance bonuses - Health, dental, and vision benefits (company pays 80% of employee premiums and 50% of dependent premiums) - Daily lunch stipend - Other benefits such as monthly wifi, cell phone and subscription reimbursement, and annual hardware stipend - Flexible PTO and remote-friendly culture - Annual Corporate Offsites - Opportunity to help shape a function at a rapidly scaling tech company

title: Influencer Marketing Manager (LatAm)
description: The Role You will own influencer and creator marketing across the entire LATAM region, translating global campaign objectives into regional plans, managing a direct team, and running the full lifecycle from creator prospecting through post-campaign analysis. This role sits at the intersection of strategy and daily execution, and the person in it will be the primary connection point between LATAM creators and the cross-functional teams that power Moises campaigns. The creator channel is one of the most important acquisition surfaces for Moises in Latin America, and this role shapes its performance. What You Will Work On Define the regional creator strategy, including selection criteria, partnership models (one-off, long-term, exclusivity), priority music verticals, and content guidelines for LATAM campaigns. Manage the LATAM influencer marketing budget end to end, tracking spend against plan, flagging variances, and ensuring financial discipline across all active campaigns. Lead your team through the full campaign roadmap, from scheduling and creator negotiations to delivery, brand compliance, and escalations when deals fall outside standard parameters. Track campaign KPIs in real time, identify underperformance early, and deliver post-campaign analyses with clear recommendations to the Director of Creators. Coordinate with Finance, Legal, Growth, Data, Product, and Social teams to keep regional creator initiatives aligned with global strategy and compliant with LATAM regulations, including CONAR in Brazil. Lead your team's development through structured feedback, roadmap alignment, and clearing the blockers that slow execution. Required 5 or more years in influencer marketing, creator partnerships, or artist relations, including at least 3 years directly managing a team. Proven experience running creator campaigns across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube, with fluency in performance metrics like ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion rates. Experience managing regional or campaign-level marketing budgets with accountability for results, not just spend. Working proficiency in English (required for internal communication) and fluency in Portuguese; Spanish at any level is a plus, not a requirement. Familiarity with influencer marketing compliance frameworks in LATAM, particularly CONAR, and experience collaborating with Legal on creator contracts. Solid experience driving digital acquisition for subscription-based or app products, ideally from tech, digital, fintech, music, or gaming companies. Consumer goods backgrounds are considered only with a strong fit on the other criteria. Nice to Have Personal experience as a musician, producer, or active participant in the music tech world. An existing network of music creators in Brazil and broader LATAM. Experience in product-led growth or freemium SaaS models. What It Is Like to Work Here Moises is a distributed team of under 150 people with offices in João Pessoa, Salt Lake City, and São Paulo. The LATAM marketing team works across time zones, and this role offers real flexibility in how you structure your days, as long as you're available to your team and cross-functional partners when it matters. This is a role with genuine ownership. You define the regional strategy, manage the budget, lead the team, and own the results. You will work closely with the Director of Creators and have direct relationships with Legal, Finance, Growth, and Product, but the day-to-day calls are yours to make. That means you need to be comfortable with ambiguity and with being accountable for outcomes, not just activity. Music is not backdrop here. The creators you work with are musicians, producers, educators, and performers who use Moises as a genuine part of how they make and share music. Understanding that world, what these creators care about, how they talk, and what makes a partnership feel authentic versus transactional, is a real advantage in this role. title: Director, Digital Retail Partnership and Marketing
description: Who We Are: The Orchard is a leading full-service music distribution company operating in 48 markets worldwide and servicing top global independent artists and labels. With cutting-edge operations and an unparalleled global team, The Orchard partners with clients to provide full scale solutions across a variety of verticals. Championed by an exceptional community of music lovers and experts, The Orchard empowers creators to grow and evolve in the dynamic, global industry. The Orchard focuses on providing a comfortable, social, and engaging environment to encourage productivity and creativity. The role: The Director, Digital Retail Partnership and Marketing leads our Greater China’s Marketing strategy and amplify our label and artist clients’ reach, as well as to oversee end-to-end marketing campaigns and maximize revenue opportunities across digital channels. A central pillar of this role is owning and scaling our YouTube ecosystem, including channel optimization, rights management, and audience growth strategies, to directly boost exposure and monetization for our distributed music contents. What you'll do: Strategic Marketing & Campaign Management • Lead the Digital Sales and Marketing team to develop and execute multi-channel marketing campaigns across the region for label clients, artist releases, and catalog tracks to drive streams, sales, and global cultural relevance. • Collaborate directly with record labels to align marketing initiatives with release timelines and revenue goals. • Direct audience segmentation, playlist pitching strategies, and influencer / creator outreach. YouTube Business & Monetization Leadership • Manage & Scale Strategy: Drive the overall development and maximize our revenue for our YouTube business. • Optimization & Growth: Oversee channel management, metadata optimization, custom thumbnails, and video SEO across owned and distributed channels. • Audience Development: Leverage YouTube Analytics to identify trends, expand subscriber bases, and create content strategies that translate views into DSP streams. Brand Strategy & Industry Relations • Position our distribution platform as an industry-leading service provider for independent record labels and artists. • Build and maintain direct relationships with key partners at major DSPs (Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube Music, QQ Music, NetEase etc). Analytics • Define KPIs for all marketing campaigns and deliver regular reports to track results, evaluate performance, and optimize ongoing strategy. • Utilize data-driven insights to refine campaign strategies continuously. Who you are: • 8+ years of progressive marketing experience in the music industry (Music Distributor, Record Label, or Music Tech). • Demonstrated YouTube Expertise: Proven track record of managing high-volume YouTube channels, Content ID strategy, and YouTube monetization within the music space. • Extensive experience in digital space including music retail, analytics, social media and digital music distribution with an ability to adapt to a constantly changing landscape. • Proven experience to manage a team of skilled and driven individuals. • Highly advanced organizational skills with the ability to multi-task and prioritize tight deadlines. • Excellent oral and written communication skills in both English and Chinese. What we give you: • You join a vibrant global community with the opportunity to channel your passion every day. • A modern office environment designed for you, empowering you to bring your best. • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community. • The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt and create what happens next. • We give you the platform to champion positive change, with the opportunity to contribute to our social impact, diversity, equity and inclusion initiatives. Foster fan community relationships to amplify campaign reach and effectiveness. Collaborate with different The Orchard teams across the globe to identify and leverage cultural touchpoints for audience acquisition, engagement, and other label objectives. title: Catalogue Growth & Commercial Manager
description: The Senior Executive / Manager, Catalogue Growth & Commercialization plays a hybrid role across catalogue operations and commercial growth for Sony Music Entertainment Malaysia. This role is responsible for backend catalogue ingestion, optimization and M&A-related due diligence support, while also driving opportunities across D2C, website, AVOD monetization, SEO, analytics and DSP/platform optimization. title: Director, Digital Retail Partnership and Marketing- The Orchard
description: Who We Are: The Orchard is a leading full-service music distribution company operating in 48 markets worldwide and servicing top global independent artists and labels. With cutting-edge operations and an unparalleled global team, The Orchard partners with clients to provide full scale solutions across a variety of verticals. The Orchard focuses on providing a comfortable, social, and engaging environment to encourage productivity and creativity. The role: The Director, Digital Retail Partnership and Marketing leads our Greater China’s Marketing strategy and amplify our label and artist clients’ reach, as well as to oversee end-to-end marketing campaigns and maximize revenue opportunities across digital channels. A central pillar of this role is owning and scaling our YouTube ecosystem, including channel optimization, rights management, and audience growth strategies, to directly boost exposure and monetization for our distributed music contents. What you'll do: Strategic Marketing & Campaign Management • Lead the Digital Sales and Marketing team to develop and execute multi-channel marketing campaigns across the region for label clients, artist releases, and catalog tracks to drive streams, sales, and global cultural relevance. • Collaborate directly with record labels to align marketing initiatives with release timelines and revenue goals. • Direct audience segmentation, playlist pitching strategies, and influencer / creator outreach. Analytics • Define KPIs for all marketing campaigns and deliver regular reports to track results, evaluate performance, and optimize ongoing strategy. • Utilize data-driven insights to refine campaign strategies continuously. We specialize in being Artist focused, blending industry expertise and technology, leveraging data to drive success, and providing streamlined digital and physical solutions. The Orchard’s comprehensive artist & label services offerings include marketing, sync licensing, premium video services, transparent data analysis, advertising, rights management, radio promotion, D2C, and more. The Orchard focuses on providing a comfortable, social, and engaging environment to encourage productivity and creativity. You will serve as a key point of contact, keeping labels and artists ahead of industry trends, platform tools, and audience engagement with plans and best practices. Owning and nurturing strong relationships with clients and internal teams is essential to creating impactful activations, building fanbases, and achieving overall release objectives. Conceptualize and execute creative marketing campaigns in order to remain at the forefront of marketing and audience development. Oversee and manage marketing campaigns for high-priority releases, focusing on specific artist and label initiatives within a given team. Drive informed decisions based on data and performance metrics. Analyze the impact of campaigns and the value of various fan and audience segments, identifying trends, areas for improvement, and opportunities to optimize both pre- and post-release strategies. Utilize in-depth knowledge of platforms and tools to build audiences, engage fanbases, and drive demand. Provide regular reports and key insights to team and regional leads regarding campaign success and areas for improvement. Seek out opportunities for the development of the artist and label roster through internal resources and external tools or services that could enhance campaign efforts. We're a team of ML engineers, data scientists and senior marketers trusted by fast-growing B2B SaaS companies including Instantly, Granola and Composio to help generate leads and customers through Google and AI assistants like ChatGPT. We do this through a mixture of content marketing, technical optimisations and off-site brand amplification (PR, backlinks, Reddit marketing). View recent case studies at High-level overview of our approach: AI-powered operations: Our ML team builds internal tools that remove repetitive work and give marketers more time for judgement and execution. Senior judgement: Experienced marketers set the strategy and quality bar; automation supports the work rather than replacing it. Full-stack execution: We work across content, technical SEO/AEO and off-site amplification to give clients better outcomes. Note: If you want to stand out, please include a Loom video showing a tool, system or deliverable you've produced and are proud of. We'd love to see it! This role We’re hiring for a SEO/AEO Lead. You’ll manage our team of analysts and strategists, constantly raise the bar across client work and collaborate closely with product and engineering to turn client and market insights into better tools and workflows for the team. You’ll be accountable for client health, making sure the department’s quarterly net revenue retention (NRR) goal is hit and coaching the team to become best-in-class marketers who are progressing in their careers. This is not a typical management role where your value is measured by team meetings. It will be operationally intense: high context, high communication and the application of unreasonably high standards across everything we do for clients. It is fully remote, ideally within +/-4 hours of GMT, though we can be flexible for the right person. What you'll do Improve the delivery methodology. Identify better ways for us to find, diagnose and act on SEO/AEO performance opportunities that help clients win. Turn successful changes into playbooks and workflows that don’t rely on heroics. Set and maintain delivery standards. Improve how we structure deliverables, run QA, communicate with clients and collaborate as a team so clients receive a world-class experience and we maintain a culture of excellence. Coach and train the team weekly. Use structured work, call and communication reviews to give feedback, practise improvements and check that subsequent client work meets the standard. Manage performance and development. Run structured fortnightly 1:1s, quarterly reviews, and maintain individual development plans so team members are progressing in their careers and feel incentivised. Own NRR and client health. Report on retention, expansion and account health; spot risks early and work with strategists on save plans for red accounts. Build the talent bench and hire well. Build a pipeline of capable analysts and strategists for future capacity needs. Run structured assessments and interviews to evaluate ability and help close candidates. Build effective onboarding. Build and improve an onboarding curriculum so analysts and strategists reach our delivery standards faster. Sponsor product and workflow improvements. Work with product and engineering to build new tools and workflows that make your team more effective and gives clients unfair advantages. The ideal person for this role You’ve led teams before . You know how to run performance reviews, handle hard conversations and get the most out of those who work with you. You can challenge a search strategy . You can judge whether a content plan targets the right clusters, a technical recommendation deserves priority or an AEO experiment will deliver the right commercial outcomes. You operate with radical candour .

title: Content Marketing Manager
description: As a Content Marketing Manager at JivPad, you will own the voice, story, and editorial presence of a brand built to transform how people communicate. JivPad is a modern communication platform powered by AI, enabling individuals with speech or hearing differences, and anyone who desires intelligent call assistance, to connect with confidence and authenticity. Our platform also delivers real-time translation for in-person conversations, removing language barriers entirely. In this role, you will develop and execute a content strategy that educates, inspires, and converts across every stage of the customer journey. You will shape how JivPad shows up in the world, from long-form editorial and thought leadership to product storytelling and social narratives. You will work closely with Product, Design, and Growth teams to ensure every piece of content reflects the precision and warmth of the brand. This is a rare opportunity to define the editorial identity of a company from day one, where your words will shape perception, build trust, and move markets. What You'll Do Develop and own JivPad's content strategy across blog, social, email, web, and emerging channels. Create compelling long-form and short-form content including articles, case studies, product narratives, thought leadership pieces, and campaign copy. Collaborate with Product and Engineering to distil complex AI and voice technology into stories that are clear, human, and emotionally engaging. Build and manage an editorial calendar that aligns with product launches, market moments, and brand milestones. Establish JivPad's tone of voice guidelines and ensure consistency across all touchpoints and teams. Partner with SEO, Growth, and Paid teams to ensure content drives measurable organic visibility, engagement, and conversion. Champion the stories of our users, particularly those in the accessibility community, bringing their experiences to the forefront of our brand narrative. What You'll Need to Succeed A degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, English, or a related discipline, with 2+ years of experience in content marketing, editorial strategy, or brand copywriting within a technology or SaaS organisation. A portfolio demonstrating exceptional writing across formats, from editorial and thought leadership to product and campaign copy. Experience thriving in fast-paced, early-stage environments where you take ownership of the full content lifecycle from ideation to distribution. A refined sense of tone, pacing, and storytelling, with the ability to write for diverse audiences while maintaining a premium brand voice. A deeply collaborative disposition, with the ability to work cross-functionally across Product, Design, Growth, and Marketing to deliver unified narratives. Genuine passion for accessibility, inclusive technology, or communication innovation is highly valued. Role Details Employment Type: Full-Time and Part-Time positions available Location: Fully Remote Stage: Founding team, pre-launch About JivPad JivPad is a modern communication platform built on the belief that everyone deserves to be heard, understood, and in control of their own voice. Our AI-powered calling technology enables users to make phone calls with full autonomy, whether they choose to speak through AI using their own cloned voice, direct the conversation in real time via text, or seamlessly take over the call themselves. Our live translation feature allows people speaking different languages to converse naturally, in person, without delays or interruptions. We are not building another AI calling tool. We are building the future of human connection, where technology amplifies who you are rather than replacing you. Equal Opportunity JivPad is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome dedicated individuals regardless of gender, race, ethnicity, national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. title: Video Content Creator

title: CRM/Lifecycle-маркетолог
description: Навыки: Amplitude. Специализации: Маркетинг/Другое. Привет! Приоритет позиции — развитие клиентских сценариев на протяжении всего жизненного цикла: от активации и первого успешного опыта до регулярного использования, расширения и удержания. Чем предстоит заниматься: Разработать CRM-стратегию для ключевых сегментов B2B- и B2C-аудитории. Провести аудит текущих коммуникаций, данных, сегментов и клиентских сценариев. Спроектировать триггерный онбординг и автоматические цепочки на разных этапах жизненного цикла. Помогать B2B-клиентам осваивать возможности продукта, повышать adoption функций и находить новые сценарии использования YCLIENTS. Развивать омниканальные коммуникации в email, Telegram, MAX, web- и mobile-интерфейсах. Сегментировать аудиторию и подбирать для каждого сегмента релевантные сообщения, офферы, каналы и частоту контактов. Формировать коммуникационную политику: приоритеты, контактные правила, частотные ограничения и логику пересечения кампаний. Вместе с аналитиками оценивать влияние коммуникаций на activation, adoption, conversion, retention, churn и LTV. Быстро запускать пилоты, проверять гипотезы и масштабировать работающие сценарии. Совместно с продуктом, аналитикой и разработкой улучшать данные, события и инструменты, необходимые для персонализированных коммуникаций. Что для нас важно: Опыт в CRM-, lifecycle- или retention-маркетинге от трёх лет. Практический опыт работы с B2B SaaS, подписочными продуктами, trial-воронками или PLG/self-service-моделями. Уверенное владение CRM- или marketing automation-платформами: Mindbox, Customer.io, Braze, Carrot quest, Encharge или аналогами. Умение самостоятельно проектировать сегменты, триггеры, сценарии и логику автоматических цепочек. Понимание продуктовых метрик: Activation Rate, Trial-to-Paid, Adoption, Retention, Churn, ARPU и LTV. Опыт работы с Amplitude, Mixpanel, PostHog или другими системами продуктовой аналитики. Понимание событийной модели данных: events, properties, user profiles, cohorts. Умение оценивать не только просмотры и клики, но и влияние коммуникаций на продуктовое поведение и бизнес-результат. Умение писать коротко, понятно и без корпоративного канцелярита — особенно для аудитории малого бизнеса. Умение работать с дизайнером: формулировать идею, ставить задачу и оценивать, насколько креатив решает бизнес-задачу. Готовность быстро прототипировать, проверять гипотезы и принимать решения на основании данных. Умение работать с данными, формулировать гипотезы, определять показатели эффективности и оценивать результаты маркетинговых инициатив. Навыки подготовки презентаций, конкурентных сравнений, аналитических материалов и продуктовых предложений. Умение структурировать информацию, самостоятельно вести проекты и координировать работу нескольких подразделений. Будет преимуществом: Опыт продвижения серверного ПО, операционных систем, инфраструктурных платформ Опыт запуска новых продуктов и вывода решений на новые сегменты рынка. Опыт работы с крупными корпоративными заказчиками, интеграторами и партнёрским каналом. Понимание специфики сложных B2B-продаж с длительным циклом сделки и несколькими участниками принятия решения. Опыт разработки ABM-стратегий и оценки вклада маркетинга в развитие коммерческой воронки. Условия: Уверенность в будущем. У нас многие увлекаются сноубордом, лыжами, дайвингом, бегом и пр. – найти кого-то для afterwork-активностей не проблема. Мы ищем руководителя отдела маркетинга , который выстроит работу маркетинга, будет развивать бренд компании и вместе с командой развивать лидогенерацию. разные механики: таргет, рассылки и партнёрства — участвовать в конференциях и готовить спикеров — формировать и вести маркетинговый календарь — контролировать бюджет кампаний — работать в команде с SMM и дизайнерами — выстраивать совместную работу маркетинга с продажами, проектным офисом и разработкой — анализировать эффективность кампаний по CPA, CPL и ROI Мы ждём, что вы: — имеете опыт работы в B2B-маркетинге или IT от трёх лет — умеете работать с разными каналами привлечения лидов: GR, рекомендации, рекламные кампании — умеете самостоятельно организовывать онлайн- и офлайн-мероприятия — title: Product and Growth Lead
description: Навыки: UI/UX дизайн, Управление продуктами. Квалификация: Lead. Специализации: Менеджер продукта. hirix — рекрутинговый партнёр по поиску IT-талантов. Мы помогаем компаниям собирать сильные команды, а специалистам — находить проекты, где их экспертиза действительно нужна. Работаем с IT, Digital и AI и сопровождаем кандидатов от первого контакта до оффера. Сейчас наш заказчик расширяет команду и ищет Product & Growth Lead , который поможет вывести новый продукт на рынок, разобраться в потребностях пользователей и выстроить системный рост. О проекте Технологическая компания, развивающая quantitative-инфраструктуру и ML-решения для рынка цифровых активов. Проект находится на стадии pre-launch, а команда объединяет экспертизу в quant research, machine learning и blockchain-разработке. Это возможность присоединиться к проекту на раннем этапе и влиять на продуктовую стратегию, пользовательский опыт и рост — от первых интервью до запуска и масштабирования. Чем предстоит заниматься Customer discovery: проводить интервью с активными инвесторами, изучать их потребности, инструменты и критерии выбора, определять целевую аудиторию и ценностное предложение продукта; Product discovery: формировать и проверять гипотезы, приоритизировать backlog совместно с founders и engineering, запускать улучшения и оценивать их результаты; UX/UI: выстраивать пользовательский путь, улучшать onboarding и сокращать время до первой ценности. Работать с дизайнером, тестировать прототипы и самостоятельно создавать простые решения; Growth и аналитика: выстраивать воронку от привлечения до удержания, анализировать когорты, выявлять причины потерь и проводить эксперименты; Позиционирование и запуски: формулировать ценность продукта, готовить запуски новых функций и собирать обратную связь от пользователей; Контент и органический рост: развивать сайт, landing pages, блог, SEO, X (Twitter) и lifecycle-коммуникации. Самостоятельно готовить тексты и тестировать каналы дистрибуции; Community и early users: развивать сообщество первых пользователей, организовывать beta-тестирование, создавать простые продуктовые демо и выстраивать регулярную коммуникацию с аудиторией. Что важно для этой роли Практический опыт в Product, Growth или Product Marketing — ориентировочно 4–7 лет. Важнее не количество лет, а конкретные кейсы и личный вклад в результат; Опыт в FinTech — особенно в брокеридже, инвестиционных приложениях или сервисах для активных инвесторов; Навыки customer discovery и практический опыт работы над onboarding, activation и retention; Уверенное владение продуктовой аналитикой: умение работать с метриками, когортами, качеством трафика и ограничениями небольших выборок; Хорошее понимание UX и опыт взаимодействия с дизайнерами и разработчиками; Сильный письменный русский и рабочий английский для пользовательских интервью, продуктовых текстов и коммуникации в англоязычном X; Личный опыт использования криптовалют: централизованных бирж (CEX), кошельков, переводов и стейблкоинов. Знакомство с DeFi будет преимуществом; Самостоятельность, инициативность и готовность работать в условиях ранней стадии продукта — без большой команды исполнителей и сложившихся процессов; Умение применять AI-инструменты в работе, критически оценивать результаты и проверять качество решений. Условия и возможности: Полная занятость, 5/2, гибридный/удаленный формат, офис в центре Москвы; Широкая зона ответственности на стыке продукта, аналитики, UX и growth; Возможность проверять гипотезы на практике и видеть непосредственный результат своей работы; Компенсация всех необходимых инструменты и ПО для работы.

title: Специалист по сопровождению и автоматизации CRM
description: Навыки: Битрикс24, AmoCRM. Специализации: Администрирование/Другое. Когда-то YCLIENTS был просто смелой идеей. Сегодня — это платформа, которую используют миллионы: чтобы записаться на стрижку, массаж или йогу, и чтобы управлять своим бизнесом легко, быстро и без головной боли. Мы — лидер на рынке онлайн-записи и автоматизации для сферы красоты и услуг, и уже 16 лет помогаем бизнесу расти и развиваться. За это время команда YCLIENTS выросла до 450 сотрудников, и мы продолжаем двигаться вперёд. Сейчас мы ищем коллегу, который будет настраивать бесперебойную работу CRM и автоматизировать рутину, чтобы наша команда работала как часы Чем предстоит заниматься: 1. Администрирование и поддержка CRM: Создание, сопровождение и актуализация рабочих воронок коммерции и клиентского сервиса (лидогенерация, сделки, сопровождение клиентов, внедрение, саппорт). Управление пользователями: настройка прав доступа, ролевых моделей, логики очередей и статусов сотрудников. Контроль качества данных: проверка заполнения обязательных полей, выявление дублей, разбор зависших сделок. Первая линия помощи сотрудникам: оперативный разбор обращений по сбоям, интерфейсу и логике работы систем. Настройка стандартных автоматизаций штатными средствами (роботы, автозадачи, триггеры смены статусов, умные сценарии, смарт процессы, списки). 2. Сопровождение Helpdesk: Поддержка интеграции с хелпдеском ( Eddy ): проверка создания тикетов, связок с клиентами и передачи статусов в CRM. В дальнейшем изучение и администрирование интеграций и связок CRM с IP-телефонией ( Телфин , Naumen ): контроль очередей, добавочных номеров, распределения звонков и корректности записи разговоров в карточки. 3. Выгрузки и регулярная отчетность: Подготовка операционных срезов, реестров и выгрузок по запросу руководителей направлений (воронки, активность, звонки, оплаты). 4. Другие автоматизации: Автоматизации и интеграции с такими сервисами как: телефония, месенджеры и др. Оптимизация схем работы по запросу смежных отделов. Мы сработаемся, если у тебя есть: Уверенный практический опыт работы с Битрикс24 на уровне администратора/продвинутого пользователя (настройка воронок, прав доступа, базовых роботов и триггеров). Опыт работы со службами поддержки / Service Desk ( Eddy или аналогами). Внимательность к деталям, системность и аккуратность при работе с данными. Умение читать регламенты, инструкции и блок-схемы процессов. Будет плюсом: Опыт администрирования или сопровождения корпоративной телефонии (Телфин, Naumen или аналогичных платформ), работа с amoCRM Примечание: знание языков программирования, разработка и верстка не требуются. Что мы предлагаем: Оформление по ТК РФ с первого дня и полностью белая зарплата. Полный рабочий день, график 5\2 с 10:00-19:00 по мск, удаленный формат работы - строго в пределах Российской Федерации. Молодая команда, общение на «ты». Скидки через BestBenefits (спорт, рестораны, салоны красоты). Внутренняя валюта, которую можно копить и получать за неё уникальный мерч. ДМС и сервис корпоративного психолога. Обучение за счет компании, менторство и работа с продуктом-лидером.

title: Аналитик CRM
description: Навыки: SQL, Python. Специализации: Продуктовый аналитик. Объединённая компания Wildberries и Russ — это международная технологическая компания, образованная в результате слияния двух лидеров рынка — IT-компании Wildberries и оператора наружной рекламы Russ. Вам предстоит Проводить A/B-тесты по улучшению программы лояльности (изменение коэффициента начисления баллов, введение новых уровней, запуски акций / механик, изменение условий сгорания бонусов): самостоятельно искать инсайты для бизнеса в BigData, формулировать и проверять гипотезы, разрабатывать дизайн пилота, проводить постанализ, формулировать выводы; Оценивать эффективности CRM-кампаний по программе лояльности по метрикам коммуникационной воронки (sent, deliver, click, Delivery Rate, CTR, CR, uplift, стат. значимость, CAC, ROI) и их экономическому эффекту; Сегментировать участников программы лояльности; Разрабатывать и поддерживать дашборды по программе лояльности; Формировать регулярные отчеты для стейкхолдеров с понятными выводами и рекомендациями; Создавать инструменты экспресс-анализа, калькуляторы для бизнеса. Мы ожидаем от вас Владеете SQL; Имеете опыт работы с Python (работа с данными, проведение AB-тестов); Обладаете знаниями статистики и владеете Bi-инструментами; Будет плюсом понимание ETL процессов и работы с данными (Airflow); Имеете опыт сегментации клиентов (RFM, когорты, поведенческие сегменты); Понимаете ключевые метрики программы лояльности и их влияние на верхнеуровневые метрики; Обладаете глубоким пониманием статистического анализа, проверки гипотез и планирования экспериментов; Умеете считать бизнес-кейсы и PnL-модели, рассчитывать прибыльность, маржу и LTV. Что мы предлагаем Обучение и развитие: языковые клубы, собственный корпоративный университет, программы развития управленческих навыков и многое другое; Благополучие сотрудников: корпоративный пакет ДМС со стоматологией, корпоративный спорт, консультации психолога и дополнительные возможности аккредитованной IT-компании; Множество сообществ: клуб спикеров, футбола, йоги, шахмат и т.д.; Забота о семьях: создаем условия, в которых легко сочетать карьеру и заботу о близких – от гибкого подхода до масштабных проектов для детей сотрудников; Скидки и партнерские программы: на обучение, страхование, покупки и многое другое; Комфортная рабочая среда: бесплатное питание в офисе, современные офисы рядом с метро, корпоративная техника и портал для сотрудников.

title: Marketing Manager
description: Are you an experienced marketing project manager who wants to join multicultural team? title: Brand Strategist
description: Hello! We’re currently searching for a friendly and skilled Brand&Design Strategist. Your role will be important in leading the creation of creative Brand&Design strategies that will not only help our studio grow but also make a lasting impact. If you’re passionate about making a difference and ready to take on this exciting opportunity, we’re eager to hear from you! Requirements You’ll need at least 3 years of experience as a brand/design strategist. Analytical & creative thinking. Previous experience in interacting with clients. Understanding of brand design (aesthetics, process and deliverables). Ability to work independently: you’ll have the skills to carry out projects from beginning to end on your own. You’ll know what to do even if no one tells you, and you’ll excel at taking initiative. Proficient in English Responsibilities Research: client workshop; client brand/identity analysis; competitor brand/identity analysis; other research skills (bonus, but not mandatory). Brand Strategy: Naming; Positioning; Architecture; Personality; Mission/Vision etc. Design strategy: Design Brief; Design concepts; Providing visual references. Management: Client communication; Presenting work; Managing your workload. Сollaborating with product design, illustration, and animation teams to ensure that strategy & branding are implemented consistently. What we offer Competitive compensation based on your experience and expertise Long-term contract-based collaboration A collaborative and open environment Flexible collaboration arrangements

title: Creative Marketing Manager
description: G5 Games Careers Corporate G5 University Careers Corporate G5 University en Русский (ru) Українська (uk) Careers Remote positions Open remote positions All categories Marketing & PR Management Open Positions Test tasks Apply Ad Monetization Manager Remote Practical knowledge of ads monetization and ads management, optimizations of mediation solutions; At least 3 years of experience within the casual mobile games; Understanding of ad networks operation, reading and interpreting data to communicate to developers. Creative Marketing Manager Remote We are looking for an experienced Creative Marketing Manager to develop, test, and optimize advertising creatives to improve User Acquisition performance for our mobile games. Marketing Analyst Remote Strong knowledge of Mathematical Theory, Probability and Statistics; Understanding of R/Python and practical experience with this data science toolkit; Expertise in statistical analysis techniques; Vice President of Product Remote Extensive experience in product management and product decision-making within F2P game development, preferably in casual games. Strong expertise in game design, market research, product-market fit, and scaling game portfolios. Strategic and creative thinking combined with a business-oriented mindset. FAQ How will I know if you got my response? Immediately after the response you will receive an email confirming that we have received your application. Please be careful, sometimes emails with an answer or a test task can end up in spam. Please be aware that the email correspondence with G5 Games representatives is conducted via g5.com only. How long does it take to consider the application? All responses are processed by the recruiting team within a week. If after that time you have not been contacted, it is likely that we are not ready to offer you cooperation at this stage. In any case, your resume will remain in the company's database and we will definitely return to it if suitable options appear. What are the stages of selection in the company? The selection process usually includes several stages: consideration of resume and/or portfolio → test task → interview (general and/or technical). Depending on the position and project, the number of stages and the stages themselves can vary. The recruiter will tell you more about the selection process. What does the test task include? Is it paid for? The test task includes typical tasks that our employees work with. We do not use the results of test tasks for commercial purposes, the test task is fully synthetic, so it is not paid. When will I get feedback after completing a test task? It may take up to five working days for us to review the completed test task and make a decision. After that your test task will come back to you with feedback. If it does not, feel free to remind the recruiter. Can I apply to more than one job at the same time? We do not limit the number of jobs you can apply to at one time, but your applications may be considered and further selected one by one. How often can I respond to the company's openings? If you are rejected at any stage of the selection process, we recommend that you reapply for the position no earlier than three months later. Does the company help with relocation? Yes, the company has a special relocation package. It includes: compensation of $1,000 for transportation and rent for the first time; reimbursement of expenses for medical examination, filing and translation of documents for the employee and their family. What work schedule does the company offer? Since our employees live and work in different time zones, we have a flexible work schedule. In agreement with the leader and the team, you can start the working day when it is convenient for you, and finish it after 8 hours of work. The main thing is to stay in touch and perform the necessary tasks. We do not encourage overtime and try to maintain an optimal work-life balance. If they do occur, we pay for the time worked o

Hands-on experience with other channels â TikTok, Snapchat, Pinterest, AppLovin. Deep, daily use of AI tools (Claude, Cursor, Gemini, etc.) â a hard must-have. We mean real, advanced usage: building automated workflows, analysis and reporting pipelines, creative/copy generation at scale â not just search queries or basic file editing. Strong analytical and experimentation mindset; data-driven decision making. Experience with web subscription-based or B2C digital products . title: Senior Events Marketing Specialist
description: Do you want to change how the world creates? At Formlabs, we’re building the tools that make it possible for anyone to bring their ideas to life, from cutting-edge products to life-saving medical devices. Our 3D printing technology powers innovation at more than 50,000 industry leaders worldwide, including Apple, Google, Tesla, New Balance, and NASA. Together, we’re helping everyone design, prototype, and manufacture faster than ever before. The Senior Events Marketing Specialist is based at our largest European office, in Budapest. This role works closely with Sales, Marketing, Product, Design and Leadership to shape how Formlabs shows up on some of our most important stages. This role owns the strategy, planning, execution, and performance of a portfolio of events, with a strong focus on key trade shows and Formlabs-owned events. Formlabs participates in approximately 20 trade shows annually, ranging from smaller, 12sqm booths to large-format exhibits of over 200sqm, while continuously bringing new products and applications to market. You will independently define and execute event programs, collaborate across functions to achieve clear objectives, and continuously improve how our experiential marketing efforts support the business. We’re a team of hands-on builders, engineers, and innovators reinventing how the world makes physical things. If you’re ready to shape the future of fabrication, come build it with us. The Job: Own a portfolio of various trade shows, from 12sqm to 200+sqm Develop and execute plans to achieve event objectives, ensuring milestones are met and outcomes are delivered Lead end-to-end event planning and execution, including pre/post-event campaigns, staffing, booth management, and internal enablement for demos and presentations Collaborate with the design and marketing teams to ensure event presence effectively represents the brand and showcases our growing product portfolio Manage budgets, contracts, vendors, and logistics, optimizing spend and operational efficiency across multiple event formats Serve as a visible brand ambassador, building relationships with customers, partners, and prospects onsite Gather and analyze event performance insights, using learnings to continuously improve formats, messaging, and attendee experience Collaborate across Sales, Product, Design, and Marketing teams, providing recommendations and influencing decisions to maximize event impact Responsible for ordering and tracking event inventory including collateral, giveaways, etc. Travel as needed (~25% of the time) to attend events, oversee execution, and support onsite teams - mostly within Europe You: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, or a related discipline 5+ years of experience in event marketing, including owning and executing complex B2B trade show and event programs Proven experience managing multi-event portfolios with booths ranging from small to large-format, including planning, execution, and reporting Experience supporting product launches and evolving product portfolios through events, ensuring effective market positioning Strong project management skills, highly organized, and able to manage multiple projects, resources, budgets, and onsite personnel under tight deadlines Excellent communication skills - written, oral, and cross-functional collaboration, including partnering effectively with Sales, Product, and Marketing teams Data and metric-driven, with the ability to draw insights from event and marketing data to optimize outcomes Creative, innovative, and proactive - able to identify new opportunities and think outside the box to improve event experiences Confident, friendly, and dynamic personality, able to serve as a brand ambassador at events Comfortable traveling ~25% of the time to attend events and oversee onsite execution Bonus Skills: Passion for 3D printing and emerging technologies Experience in a fast-growing startup environment We Offer: Hybrid work Catered lunch at the office 3

description: Acronis is a global leader in cyber protection, delivering AI-powered protection for productive MSPs in a single, natively integrated platform that unifies operations management, cybersecurity, and data protection. Driven by our mission to protect, manage and automate every workload that businesses and lives depend on, we’ve built the industry’s only all-in-one solution The Regional Marketing Manager will be responsible for driving marketing strategy, pipeline growth, partner recruitment, and partner engagement across India, one of Acronis' strategic growth markets in the region. The successful candidate will manage ownership of pipeline, partner growth, and AI transformation, reporting directly to Marketing Director APJMEA. WHAT YOU'LL DO Strategy: Develop and execute the annual integrated marketing strategy and plan for India, aligned with regional business objectives and revenue targets. Budget: Manage regional marketing budget, agency relationships, vendors, and MDF investments while ensuring strong return on investment. AI transformation: Build and deploy AI agents and automated workflows that improve the efficiency of marketing, partner engagement, event management, lead qualification, and reporting. Create and deploy AI-powered marketing campaigns that improve targeting, personalization, engagement, and conversion rates. Cross-team collaboration: Work closely with sales leadership, partner account managers, distributors, and strategic partners to align marketing activities with commercial priorities and territory plans. Collaborate with global marketing, product marketing, channel teams, communications, and business stakeholders to localize and execute go-to-market initiatives. Events: Own the planning and execution of industry events, executive roundtables, roadshows, partner programs, webinars, and customer engagement activities. Reporting: Monitor campaign performance, pipeline contribution, revenue impact, and marketing effectiveness, providing actionable recommendations based on data and insights. WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR 5+ years of experience in B2B technology marketing, preferably within cybersecurity, cloud, SaaS, MSP, IT services industries, on vendor, channel or agency side. Proven success in demand generation, pipeline creation, lead nurturing, and revenue-focused marketing programs. Experience supporting partner-led and channel-driven go-to-market models. Strong event, field marketing, partner marketing, and campaign management experience. Demonstrated ability to work closely with sales teams and influence executive stakeholders. Experience managing marketing budgets and measuring marketing ROI. Experience designing and implementing AI-driven marketing programs, automation workflows, copilots, agents, or other productivity-enhancing AI initiatives is strongly preferred. Self-starter with the ability to operate independently in a fast-paced, high-growth environment while managing multiple priorities across cross-functional teams. Fluency in English, both written and spoken, is essential. *Please submit your resume and application in English WHO WE ARE A Swiss company founded in Singapore in 2003, Acronis offers over twenty years of innovation with 15 offices worldwide and employees in 50+ countries. Acronis Cyber Protect is available in 26 languages in 150 countries and is used by over 21,000 service providers to protect more than 750,000 businesses. Our corporate culture centers on innovation, accountability, and impact. We encourage our people to think boldly, challenge conventional approaches, and take ownership of outcomes. As a member of our global “A-Team,” you’ll operate in a high-growth, fast-paced environment where resilience, adaptability, and a commitment to continuous improvement drive success. Strong understanding of App Store and Google Play ranking algorithms, optimization techniques, and best practices. Experience managing keyword strategies, content optimization, and organic growth initiatives across multiple markets. Proven experience with app ratings and reviews management, SERM, and reputation monitoring. Experience with CRO, A/B testing, funnel optimization, and data-driven decision-making. Strong analytical skills and experience with tools such as AppTweak, Ahrefs, AppFigures, BrandMentions, Google Analytics, Firebase, AppsFlyer, Adjust, or Amplitude. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience coordinating cross-functional teams and external contractors. English level C1 or higher. Marca e comunicação • Desenvolver a comunicação e fortalecer a presença da marca JET nos mercados internacionais. • Gerenciar as estratégias de mídias sociais e produção de conteúdo. Análise de marketing • Monitorar os resultados das campanhas e os principais indicadores de desempenho. • Elaborar relatórios gerenciais e dashboards. • Otimizar campanhas e investimentos com base em dados. • Acompanhar indicadores de aquisição e retenção de usuários. title: Head of Marketing / Marketing Lead
description: Voice is becoming the primary interface for technology. For the first time in history, we can use natural language to control and interact with our devices, services, and applications, and we’re only at the beginning of the adoption of Voice and Physical AI across industries. Current voice interactions, however, still lack a fundamental human skill: nuanced understanding of audio scenes and environments. Navigating complex auditory scenes, distinguishing between multiple voices, or focusing on a main speaker are all part of the challenge of “ teaching machines to hear like human beings. ” At ai-coustics, we’re building the audio intelligence layer and developer tooling to enable more robust and intelligent voice agents and Physical AI applications. Today, Voice AI companies like PolyAI, LiveKit, Telnyx, AssemblyAI or Telli use our SDK to prepare their agents for real-world acoustic challenges. Our models power thousands of agents worldwide and process millions of hours each month. We are backed by leading early-stage investors including Connect Ventures, Partech, Inovia Capital , as well as angel investors from HuggingFace, DeepMind and Amazon with deep expertise in AI and developer infrastructure. These partners share our vision and are helping us build a world-class team operating with high levels of responsibility and velocity . We look for people who take ownership, think systemically, and want to solve challenging real-world problems in close collaboration with our customers. Role Overview We're looking for a Head of Marketing / Marketing Lead to own and scale ai-coustics' end-to-end marketing function as we define a new category in Voice AI infrastructure. You'll own positioning, demand generation, product marketing, content, brand, and developer marketing, and translate complex audio and AI capabilities into a sharp, technical narrative that resonates with developers, technical buyers, and executive decision-makers. This is a senior, hands-on leadership role for someone who has built and scaled marketing functions at high-growth B2B / developer-first startups and is ready to do it again with full ownership. title: Vaga de Estágio em Marketing | Project Management - São Paulo

Assim, defendemos o respeito mútuo e sabemos que diferentes perspectivas impulsionam a inovação, aceleram o crescimento e levam a decisões e resultados mais sustentáveis. Se você se juntar a nós, independentemente de onde ou em qual posição, iremos apoiá-lo para entregar o seu melhor e seu máximo potencial. Nossa empresa pioneira que, em menos de 15 anos, conseguiu conquistar mais de 20% do mercado de música digital no Brasil e atualmente tem operações no México, Estados Unidos, Colômbia, Argentina, Peru, Argentina, Chile, Jamaica, Espanha, Nigéria, Vietnã e mais. Em maio de 2025, a ONErpm possui mais de 45 escritórios em 35 países em praticamente todos os continentes ao redor do mundo. No dia a dia, você auxiliará na atualização de informações em sistemas internos, organização de materiais, apoio na elaboração de briefings, conferência de conteúdos e suporte à preparação de relatórios. Seu papel será garantir que os processos aconteçam de forma organizada e que as equipes tenham as informações necessárias para executar suas atividades. Organizar informações e materiais para a elaboração de apresentações e estudos de caso. Apoiar pesquisas de mercado sobre tendências da indústria musical e do ambiente digital. Dar suporte aos processos administrativos e ao acompanhamento de fluxos internos. Auxiliar na organização de reuniões, agendas e materiais de alinhamento entre as equipes. You also know social media well enough to make sure every piece gets the reach it deserves. About 80% creation, 20% distribution know-how. Freelance, 2–3 days per week Why we believe in this role? Groover speaks every day to a community of 900,000 independent artists in 186 countries. Content is one of our strongest growth levers: it is how artists discover us, trust us and decide to launch their first campaign. Today we produce a lot, across many hands. We now need one senior contractor who can turn our briefs into content that looks great and performs, with more volume and higher quality. That means someone who also knows social media well enough to make every piece of content work harder for acquisition. Join us to shape how independent artists all over the world discover Groover. Missions Create: shoot, edit and design short-form video, photo and visual content for Meta, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Groover Blog, etc. This is the core of the role. Deliver fast: get briefed in the morning and ship finished content in a day, 48 hours or a week, depending on complexity. Refresh what we have: remake and improve existing content and ad creatives so they perform better. Bring your eye: strong taste, a clear visual identity and ideas that go beyond the brief. Make it perform: recommend the best format, hook, caption and posting time for each piece, and spot trends and platform hacks before they peak. Orchestrate publishing: coordinate with our intern and other freelancers so content goes out on time and on brand. Coordinate external production: when a project needs extra hands, help scope it, brief external creators or studios, and make sure what comes back matches the brand and quality bar. Measure and iterate: share what’s working and what isn’t with Dorian and Myriam, and double down on the formats that drive New Paying Customers. Work across teams: partner with Myriam on performance marketing and with Thomas to turn curators and services into great content stories.

title: Growth Lead Creator
description: Intro We believe talent is everywhere. The chance to live from it isn't. Millions of creators are talented and invisible at the same time. The value they create flows to middlemen, while the brands who want to reach them are stuck in a non-transparent, fragmented market. So we built the tools to fix both sides at once. Creators turn an account into an income: join a campaign in minutes, make something they're proud of, and get paid fairly for creativity, not follower count. Brands brief once, activate hundreds of creators, and see content live within 24 hours. Next year, 10,000 creators will make a living from WePush. When a creator earns, a brand grows. When a brand grows, more creators earn. WePush is the fastest-growing creator marketing platform in Europe, with over 150,000 creators and 500,000+ collaborations powering brands like L'Oréal, ABOUT YOU, Zalando, and Sony Music. Two numbers matter to us: how many people make a living through WePush, and how many millions of people brands reach through them. The role: Getting from 150,000 creators on the platform to 10,000 creators living from it is a growth problem, and it's yours. You own the creator side of our marketplace end to end: how creators find us, how fast they book their first campaign, and why they keep coming back. We're looking for a Growth Lead who thinks in equations, not channels: someone who can break creator growth into its parts, find the one term that's holding the rest back, and move it. You report directly to the founders. DACH is the starting point, and international expansion begins in Q1. Tasks What you'll do: Take our creator funnel apart, from first touch to signup, first booking, and repeat bookings, and tell us where the leverage is and where we're leaking Bulk of your time: Run growth experiments, kill the losers fast, and scale the winners Own the creator numbers: acquisition and CAC, retention rate, booking speed, booked revenue and all other relevant creator growth metrics. Build and run lifecycle and email marketing that gets creators activated, booked, and back for the next campaign Oversee performance marketing for creator acquisition, with your own budget logic and a clear view of what a creator is worth Work closely with product: onboarding, activation, and everything that decides whether a creator books in minutes or drops off Turn what works into playbooks that hold up outside DACH, so launching the next market is a rollout, not a restart Build creator events as a growth channel, similar to what we do for advertisers with"The30"(the30berlin.com) Every initiative starts with a hypothesis, an expected outcome, and a number that decides whether it live. You measure outcomes, not activity. Requirements You're a strong fit if.. You've founded a company or led growth at a startup or scale-up, and you can show what you moved: the metric, the starting point, and where you left it You're a numbers person first. You build your own analysis, you're at home in SQL or a serious spreadsheet, and you don't wait for a dashboard to exist before forming an opinion You find bottlenecks for a living: given a funnel, you can say which step is worth fixing and which ones are a distraction You're a real allrounder across analytics, email and lifecycle marketing, and performance marketing, and you've done each of them hands-on, not just briefed an agency You understand product well enough to know when the fix is a campaign and when it's a change to the onboarding flow High agency and full ownership: you treat the creator funnel like your own P&L, and you'd rather ship a test today than present a strategy next month Fluent English, ideally German too, since DACH is where we start. Ideally you also know the creator economy from the inside Not expected: A specific number of years on your CV. We care about what you built and what you moved, not how long it took you to get here A background in creator or influencer marketing. Strong growth people learn the market
